name: Yes Mean Yes
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of truthful and consistent speech, teaching that a believer's 'Yes' must mean 'Yes' and their 'No' must mean 'No,' as anything beyond this arises from evil (Matthew 5:37). Honoring commitments, even when it brings personal loss, reflects a life that fears the Lord and values integrity (Psalms 15:4). God delights in those who deal truthfully, and His people are called to speak truth to their neighbors and uphold justice and peace (Proverbs 12:22; Zechariah 8:16). This foundation of honest communication aligns with the command not to break oaths but to fulfill them faithfully before the Lord (Matthew 5:33).
